fao-fbs.en: FAO. 2025. FAOSTAT: Food Balances (2010-). Licence: CC-BY-4.0.
fao-fbs.note: Food supply quantity per person for China, mainland; China, Hong Kong SAR; China, Macao SAR; and China, Taiwan Province of. The file for Asia, released October 2025. The latest year's figures are FAO's estimates.
fao-fbs.noteZh: 取中国大陆、中国香港特别行政区、中国澳门特别行政区和中国台湾省的人均食物供应量，亚洲分卷，2025年10月发布。最新年份为粮农组织估计值。

moa-food-balance.note: Net food supply per person per year, in kilograms, from the sheet for 2025. Used with attribution, as the ministry's open-data declaration allows; the same table is also published as open data under the Open Government Data License, version 1.
moa-food-balance.noteZh: 取2025年平衡表的每人每年纯粮食供给量（千克）。依农业部网站资料开放宣告注明出处使用；同一表格亦依政府资料开放授权条款第1版公开。
